_source.encoding: pub and message hex lowercase; sig base64url without padding, raw r||s; ECDSA is randomized, verify never byte-compare

_rules: key_cases: the desktop's decision on a key.add or key.remove from `before`, with the stored state `after`. answer_cases: rule 1 (verifying key) and rule 1w (approve or deny only) of AnswerGate; pass means the answer goes on to rule 2 unchanged. decide: the phone's answer to a Watch answer_request, first match wins. replies: one answered frame per result with the Watch's text.

key_cases.name: add_first
key_cases.why: no key stored; signed by id_pub

key_cases.name: add_repeat
key_cases.why: the same pub and at again: key.ok, nothing changes

key_cases.name: remove
key_cases.why: signed by the watch key it removes

key_cases.name: remove_repeat
key_cases.why: a repeat of the remove already applied

key_cases.name: readd
key_cases.why: a new watch key after a remove

key_cases.name: add_extra_key
key_cases.why: a sixth key

key_cases.name: add_missing_at
key_cases.why: no at

key_cases.name: add_at_string
key_cases.why: at is not an integer

key_cases.name: add_kind_phone
key_cases.why: kind is not watch

key_cases.name: add_pub_is_id_pub
key_cases.why: the approval key cannot be its own watch key

key_cases.name: add_pub_off_curve
key_cases.why: y flipped in its last bit: not on the curve

key_cases.name: add_pub_uppercase
key_cases.why: uppercase hex is outside the grammar

key_cases.name: add_pub_compressed
key_cases.why: a compressed point is outside the grammar

key_cases.name: add_signed_by_watch_key
key_cases.why: a key cannot vouch for itself

key_cases.name: add_body_other_phone
key_cases.why: signed for another phone_id; the desktop rebuilds the body with the envelope's from

key_cases.name: add_answer_domain
key_cases.why: signed under the answer domain

key_cases.name: add_at_not_signed
key_cases.why: at changed after signing

key_cases.name: add_replayed_after_remove
key_cases.why: the old add replayed after the remove

key_cases.name: add_older_than_stored
key_cases.why: an older add after a newer one

key_cases.name: add_same_at_other_pub
key_cases.why: a different key at the stored at

key_cases.name: remove_signed_by_identity
key_cases.why: a remove is signed by the watch key, not id_pub

key_cases.name: remove_wrong_pub
key_cases.why: names a key that is not the stored one

key_cases.name: remove_none_stored
key_cases.why: nothing to remove

key_cases.name: remove_stale
key_cases.why: at not after the stored add

key_cases.name: remove_after_removed_new_at
key_cases.why: already removed, and not a repeat

key_cases.name: remove_kind_phone
key_cases.why: kind is not watch

answer_cases.name: watch_approve
answer_cases.why: rule 1 under watch_pub, rule 1w allows approve

answer_cases.name: phone_approve_unchanged
answer_cases.why: no key: frames-v3 exactly, id_pub verifies

answer_cases.name: phone_always_unchanged
answer_cases.why: the Face ID key may still choose always

answer_cases.name: watch_tell
answer_cases.why: only approve or deny from the Watch

answer_cases.name: watch_option
answer_cases.why: a question's choice is not the Watch's

answer_cases.name: watch_sig_without_marker
answer_cases.why: no key: verified under id_pub, which did not sign it

answer_cases.name: phone_sig_with_watch_marker
answer_cases.why: key watch: verified under watch_pub, which did not sign it

answer_cases.name: watch_none_stored
answer_cases.why: this desktop never accepted a watch key

replies.message: That PC is no longer paired
